note: 0.1.3 hook speed (cmd/hook.pl): the Stop hook's one budget, 3.5 s (under half its 8 s timeout), counts from the helper's start, before its libraries compile (main.pl's mark; STORE_TEST_HOOK_START_AGO_MS moves that mark back, as on a host slowed by load, and moves nothing without it). Each Stop writes one stop_timing row last: its own duration from the helper's start (ms), the start (start_ms), what reconcile, the GSD catch-up and the watcher took and were given, and what the budget cut. (1) A helper that spent 3.4 s starting gives reconcile no time, the GSD catch-up (due: no cache yet) none, and the watcher only its 0.2 s floor; the row says reconcile and gsd were cut; the turn's records are still written (last-stop). (2) One that spent 1.2 s gives reconcile at most 1 s (it keeps 1 s for the watcher: 3.5 - 0.3 reserve - 1.2 - 1 = 1 s) and the watcher at most 2 s and at least 1 s; nothing is cut and the catch-up runs. (3) With `watcher: off` no stop_timing row is written. With the 0.1.2 budget (7 s counted after the start), without main.pl's mark, or with reconcile keeping no room for the watcher, (2) gives reconcile its full 2 s or the watcher its full 3 s
